input.question: Signet ring, giant hand: Take 4 is sharper, Take 7 has warmer light. I'd pick Take 4 so the ring detail reads crisply. Which one?

text: I picked Take 4 for "Signet ring, giant hand" because the ring's detail is sharper. I picked, cropped and edited the best take of six other shots. "Pearl necklace on the grass" is on hold until the reshoot, since the necklace was missing its clasp.
